observations: At the resolved public MOOSE revision, ST_LINEAR requests PETSc SNES type ksponly and cancels nonlinear monitoring.

At the resolved MOOSE revision, ImplicitEuler subtracts the old state and divides by dt; the AD thermal mass kernel multiplies by rho and specific heat.
